title: Tinyland v4 Bazel action plan
description: Exact projection of GloriousFlywheel Core.dhall action intent for the v4 ci-templates workflow. It contains only Bazel actions and abstract REAPI capability requirements; no runner, pool, resolved platform, endpoint, credential, tenant, repository identity, lifecycle, publication, or apply authority.

schema_version.description: Breaking v4 plan interface. Version 2 removes every attachment and lifecycle field from lanes.json.

actions.description: Bazel actions keyed by their log and evidence identity. JSON object keys make action names unique by construction; the v4 workflow dispatches every entry exactly once through the compiled GF action client.

capability.description: Abstract REAPI capability from GloriousFlywheel Core.dhall. The provider resolves it to a concrete platform and worker supply; this value is never a runner label or resolved gloriousflywheel-rbe-* platform identity.

command.description: Bazel command passed verbatim to the compiled GF action client.

targets.description: Finite workspace-local Bazel labels passed verbatim to the compiled v4 action client. Flags and external-repository labels are not accepted.

capabilities.description: Abstract execution requirements joined to provider supply by the GF controller.
